verdict.rationale: Klaviyo publishes an llms.txt at www.klaviyo.com/llms.txt that orients agents toward its public APIs and MCP server. However, the probe found no llms.txt on the developer docs site (developers.klaviyo.com/llms.txt returned 404), so an agent cannot be pointed at a machine-readable index of the API reference itself. The evidence also shows no llms-full.txt or markdown docs variant. Missing for 10: llms.txt on the developer docs domain, an agent-oriented or llms-full index of API reference content, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent consumption.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Klaviyo is also accessible headlessly — through its public APIs and MCP server — so people and AI agents can read, write, and act on Klaviyo data from outside the Klaviyo interface.
